name: 78009 · Castroville, TX
findings: ZIP 78009 (Castroville) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (20%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78009 (Castroville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
